description: Known periodic planar three-body orbits with zero angular momentum and isosceles collinear initial configuration r1=(-1,0), r2=(1,0), r3=(0,0), v1=v2=(vx,vy), v3=-2(vx,vy)/m3, G=1, m1=m2=1. 'canon' is our canonical reduced syzygy word computed by integrating the published initial condition with verifier.integrate (None when the published 10-digit initial condition does not return to within 1e-2 in float64).
sources: Li & Liao, Sci. China-Phys. Mech. Astron. 60, 129511 (2017); arXiv:1705.00527; data: github.com/sjtu-liao/three-body
Li, Jing & Liao, Publ. Astron. Soc. Japan 70, 64 (2018); arXiv:1709.04775; data: github.com/sjtu-liao/three-body
Suvakov & Dmitrasinovic, Phys. Rev. Lett. 110, 114301 (2013), Table I; arXiv:1303.0181
not_included: Hristov, Hristova, Puzynin, Puzynina, Sharipov, Tukhliev 2021-2024 (arXiv:2111.10839, 2203.02793, 2308.16159; >12,000 equal-mass orbits, db2.fmi.uni-sofia.bg/3body)
Dmitrasinovic, Hudomal, Shibayama, Sugita 2018 (J. Phys. A 51, 315101; ~200 orbits) and Jankovic & Dmitrasinovic 2016
Li & Liao free-fall (2019) and 3D (2025) catalogs (different initial configurations)
orbits with nonzero angular momentum (Broucke, Henon, Hadjidemetriou families)
